place.name: Kazimierz
place.description: Kazimierz (Polish pronunciation: [kaˈʑimjɛʂ]; Latin: Casimiria; Yiddish: קוזמיר, romanized: Kuzimyr) was historically a city and is now a district incorporated into Kraków, Poland. Until 1954 the VIII quarter of the city, it is now part of the District I Old Town.
